title: MaxDmold

sections.heading: MaxDmold
sections.text: Feed ingredients are highly susceptible to mold contamination due to moisture, extended storage periods, and inconsistent raw material quality. These conditions promote fungal growth and the production of harmful mycotoxins, leading to compromised feed safety, nutrient losses, and reduced animal performance and health. MaxDmold is a bio-copper–based, dual-action mold inhibitor powered by globally recognized ANBioT® Technology. It provides effective and natural control of molds while supporting feed shelf life, nutrient preservation, and animal productivity in antibiotic-free and residue-free production systems. Components Bio Active Copper

sections.heading: Components
sections.text: Bio Active Copper Mode of Action Cell Membrane Disruption – Plant phytoactives destabilize fungal cell walls, leading to leakage and cell death. Metabolic Interference – Inhibits key enzymatic pathways required for mold growth & replication. Oxidative Stress Modulation – Natural phenols induce oxidative imbalance within fungal cells. Mineral-Stabilised Action – Bioactive copper enhances persistence & uniform activity across feed matrices.
